guidance_ledger.guided_value: near-full utilization of existing smelter capacity, ~4.6-4.7 lakh MT/yr
guidance_ledger.delivery_history: Volume guidance has consistently been the most reliable metric family in the ledger; production has tracked near-target for several years.

guidance_ledger.guided_value: incremental ~200kt (cut down from an original 500kt guide) via 5th stream ramp, originally guided for Jun-2026 commissioning
guidance_ledger.given_on: multiple quarters FY2025-FY2026, progressively revised down
guidance_ledger.delivery_history: Guided volume cut twice within FY2026 (500kt->300kt->200kt); guided Jun-2026 commissioning date already passed as of Jul-2026 access date with commissioning unconfirmed (commissioning-support tender still pre-bid as of 01-Jul-2026); consistent with a broader ~18-month historical pattern of timeline slippage on capacity projects.

guidance_ledger.guided_value: captive bauxite supply to reduce input cost once operational; MDO awarded
guidance_ledger.delivery_history: MDO award is a concrete milestone (Dec-2025) but first captive ore flow / cost-offset realization timing is not yet independently corroborated.

guidance_ledger.guided_value: capex plans historically understate actual spend
guidance_ledger.given_on: recurring pattern across FY2024-FY2026 capex disclosures
guidance_ledger.delivery_history: Confirmed recurring overrun of ~20% vs plan; applied in estimates as an upward capex/finance-cost bias rather than taken at face value.

Management price commentary is directionally useful but is corroborated against, not substituted for, independent sources (World Bank CMO, Platts) per citation-standard confidence hierarchy; management commentary sits within/near the independent forecast band.

capex_plan.purpose: 5th-stream alumina refinery capacity expansion plus Kayathar wind power (INR 163cr)
capex_plan.commissioning_timeline: Originally guided Jun-2026; unconfirmed as of Jul-2026 access date (DR1b), commissioning-support tender still pre-bid as of 01-Jul-2026

pe_bands.premium_discount_note: CMP implies fwd P/E FY27E/FY28E of 11.0x/11.7x, above the FY22-FY26 historical band (4.6x-8.7x, median 7.6x) despite base-case EPS being roughly flat over the estimate horizon -- consistent with the market pricing in either a structurally higher multiple (post cyclical-peak re-rating) or partial credit for 5th-stream/Pottangi optionality that this base case discounts. Domestic peer P/E medians were not located in DR2 sector research (data gap); only one international peer forward P/E (Alcoa, 10.04x) was found, which sits below NALCO's implied forward multiples.

base.rationale: Drivers-based build with near-rated-capacity metal volumes, external-anchored (World Bank/Platts) price normalization off the FY26 cyclical peak, and a probability-weighted (0.40/0.55) 5th-stream alumina ramp given its low guidance credibility and DR1b's unconfirmed-commissioning finding -- yields roughly flat EPS over FY26-FY28E.

bull.rationale: 5th-stream/Pottangi delivered in full at guided nameplate (no probability discount), metal/alumina prices hold at the upper end of independent+management ranges, and modest margin expansion from Pottangi's captive-ore cost offset.

bear.rationale: 5th-stream/Pottangi contribute zero volume in the horizon (continuation of the demonstrated ~18-month slip pattern), metal price falls to Goldman Sachs' bear case (~$2,400/t CY2027) and alumina to $260/t on deepening Indonesian oversupply, and the confirmed capex-overrun pattern continues to inflate finance costs.

growth_drivers: Aluminium metal volumes near rated smelter capacity (credible, high-confidence guidance family)
5th-stream alumina refinery ramp (probability-weighted, not guaranteed -- low guidance credibility, unconfirmed commissioning as of Jul-2026)
Pottangi captive bauxite mine (MDO awarded Dec-2025) as a medium-term input-cost offset
Global aluminium/alumina price cycle, anchored to World Bank CMO and Platts FOB Australia independent forecasts rather than management guidance alone
key_risks_to_estimates: 5th-stream commissioning slips further or ramps below the probability-weighted volume assumed in the base case (guidance credibility scored low; ~18-month historical slip pattern; DR1b found commissioning unconfirmed as of Jul-2026 despite the guided date having passed)
Confirmed capex-execution overrun (~20% historically, F-FUND-04) continues, inflating D&A and finance costs beyond the base-case allowance
Aluminium/alumina prices revert toward the independent forecasts' lower tracks (Goldman Sachs bear case ~$2,400/t metal; continued Indonesian alumina oversupply) faster than assumed
Q4 FY2026 PAT already down -17% YoY (F-PQ4-115) -- a signal that the FY26 full-year cyclical-peak margin (48.27%) may be harder to sustain than the base case's already-conservative fade assumes
No domestic peer P/E benchmark was available in DR2 research to cross-check the implied forward multiple -- data gap flagged, not filled

rating.thesis_one_line: N/A - rating and target price are set by the downstream valuation/peer agent, not by estimates-builder.
rating.variant_view: Base case is materially more conservative on EPS (~flat FY26-FY28E) than management's own bullish framing of the 5th-stream ramp and price outlook (guidance.json executive tone_verdict: 'Bullish / self-confident'), because the 5th-stream/Pottangi volume upside -- the single largest swing factor in the model -- is scored low-credibility by the guidance ledger and its commissioning remains unconfirmed per DR1b as of Jul-2026, so it is probability-weighted rather than taken at face value. Management's own price guidance ($3,000-3,100/t metal, $300-310/t alumina) is broadly in line with the independent (World Bank/Platts) anchors used here.

data_gaps: FY2026 CFO, capex, FCF, net_debt, ROE and ROCE not available -- FY2026 annual report not yet published as of run date; only Q4 PPT summary figures exist
FY2024 EBITDA, depreciation, interest and other-income breakouts not separately available on a consolidated basis in the fact store -- left null rather than invented
Domestic peer forward P/E multiples not located in DR2 sector/peer research -- only one international peer (Alcoa, fwd P/E 10.04x) found
EV/EBITDA and P/B multiples (ttm and 5y median) not computed -- net debt / book value series incomplete in the current fact set for a reliable EV build
FCF not computed for FY2026E/FY27E/FY28E -- capex-plan funding/maintenance-vs-growth split not disclosed with enough granularity to separate maintenance capex from the 5th-stream growth tranche
